scientific_integrity: All 32767 nonzero quartics are scanned; algebraic-closure smoothness decided by exact Groebner bases in every standard affine chart; finite-field point sampling is not used as a geometric proof.
scientific_limitations: No claim for fields other than F_2, for higher/lower degree, or for geometric isomorphism distinctness of the four representatives over an algebraic closure. Older complete genus-three classification supplies ambient normal forms, not tangent-filling data.
scientific_scope: Geometrically smooth plane quartics over F_2 with exactly three rational points; rational tangent-line coverings of the seven-point projective plane; PGL_3(F_2) orbit counts.
title: Sharp three-point tangent filling by smooth binary plane quartics
